DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご自身に起きたことから教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Start by telling me what happened to you personally.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と同僚の二人が困っています。同僚の話もまとめて、同じ被害として伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分と同僚の話をまとめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A colleague and I are both having trouble. I'd like to combine their account with mine and report it as the same harm.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to combine your and your colleague's accounts. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ日時や場所の出来事でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did these events happen at the same time and place?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 違います。私は昨日、同僚は先週だと聞きました。同じ相手かも確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日時と相手の同一性が未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. Mine was yesterday; I heard theirs was last week. I haven't confirmed it's the same person involved either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the timing and identity of the other person are not confirmed to match. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、別の話を同じ出来事と決めずに説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then explain without deciding separate accounts describe the same event.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。先に自分に起きたことを話し、同僚の分は聞いた話と明確にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の出来事と伝聞を区別して話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I'll describe what happened to me first and clearly identify my colleague's account as something I heard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish your own event from hearsay. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同僚ご本人からの説明が必要になる場合もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: An explanation from your colleague personally may be needed too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同僚には自分で相談する方法を伝えます。私が同僚の気持ちや事実を勝手に決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同僚には本人相談を案内し代わりに断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell them how to seek advice themselves. I won't decide their feelings or the facts for them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Direct your colleague to consult personally and avoid making assertions for them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ご自身の日時や経過を記録してお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Have you brought notes of your own dates and events?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモがあります。自分の記録と同僚のメッセージを分けて見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の記録と同僚のメッセージを分けて提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have notes. I'll show my own record separately from my colleague's messages.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Present your own record and your colleague's messages separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人の説明を中心に、担当者が必要な確認を行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The staff will carry out necessary checks centered on your own explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 郵便物についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a postal item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。さっきこの前のポストへ入れましたが、部屋番号を間違えました。開けて返してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 投函後の宛先誤りと取り戻しを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I just put it in the postbox out front, but wrote the wrong room number. Could you open it and return it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an address error and retrieval after posting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: すぐにポストからお返しできるとは限りません。差出し状況を担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can't necessarily return it from the postbox immediately. Staff will check the circumstances of posting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ窓口の発送前だと思うのとは違うんですね。投函した時刻と封筒の特徴を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発送前の訂正と違うと理解し投函情報を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So this differs from a correction before sending at the counter. I'll give the posting time and envelope features.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand it differs from a pre-dispatch correction and give posting details. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お願いします。手紙には、ご自身の差出人住所も書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do. Did you also write your own sender address on the letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。白い封筒で、右下に私の名前があります。中身は申請書です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 封筒の特徴と差出人表示を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. A white envelope with my name at the lower right. Inside is an application form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the envelope and sender information. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対応方法や受付条件は担当者が案内します。取り戻せると決まる前に、同じ申請書をまた送りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff will explain options and acceptance conditions. Before knowing if it can be retrieved, will you send the same application again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二重提出になるかもしれないので、今は再送しません。先にこの手紙への対応を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二重提出を避け再送を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't resend now because it might be a duplicate submission. I'll first check what can be done about this letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid duplicate submission and defer resending. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。正しい宛先も記録しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Make a note of the correct destination too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。誤った部屋番号と正しい番号を分けてメモし、担当者へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 誤宛先と正宛先を区別して担当者に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I'll note the incorrect and correct room numbers separately and consult the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish incorrect and correct addresses and consult the staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。投函後の郵便物の相談として担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. I'll refer this to staff as a query about mail already posted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込人のお名前はこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this the correct remitter's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の支払いなので、私の名前ではなく会社名にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事の支払いで会社名の名義を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a company payment, so I'd like the company name rather than my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request the company name for a work payment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社から、どの名義で払うよう指示されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: What name has the company instructed you to use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 金額と口座だけです。会社名にすれば、会社の口座から払ったように見えると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名義の指示がなく会社口座になると誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: They only gave the amount and account. I thought using the company name would make it look like payment from the company account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain there were no name instructions and your mistaken belief it would count as the company account. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示する名義と、実際に支払う口座は別の情報です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The displayed name and the account actually paying are separate information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうですね。会社の口座を使うことにはなりません。経理に個人から払ってよいか先に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示名義と支払い口座を区別し経理へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: You're right. It won't mean using the company account. I'll first ask accounting whether I may pay personally.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish displayed name and paying account and check with accounting. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その確認が済むまで、手続きは保留しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you put the procedure on hold until that is checked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。名義も含めた指示が届いてから決めたいです。今の記入は確定しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社の指示が来るまで手続きを保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I want to decide after instructions including the name arrive. Please don't finalize the current entry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hold the procedure until company instructions arrive. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。会社への確認内容を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Let's organize what to check with the company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 金額、振込名義、個人立替の可否を聞きます。返事が来てから必要な手続きを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金額・名義・立替の可否の確認点を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask about the amount, remitter's name, and whether personal advance payment is allowed. I'll consult on the necessary procedure after the reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize checks on amount, name, and permission to advance payment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。本日は振込を実行せず、確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We won't execute the transfer today; we'll guide you after confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品をまとめて会計しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall we ring these items up together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社用の飲み物と、家族用の食品があります。会社へ出す記録は別にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社用と私用の買い物記録を分けたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are drinks for the company and food for my family. I'd like separate records for submission to the company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for separate company and personal purchase records. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ会計前なので、商品を分けて確認できます。どれが会社用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's before payment, so we can separate and check. Which are for the company?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この飲み物四本です。残りは私用です。支払いも会社分と私用を別にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社用商品を特定し支払いも分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: These four drinks. The rest is personal. I'd also like separate payments for company and personal items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify company items and request separate payments too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二回の会計として承ります。会社の記録の形式は指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll do two transactions. Has the company specified the record format?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: レシートでよいと聞きました。会社名の領収書が必要とは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社が求める記録形式を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I heard a till receipt is fine. I wasn't told a formal receipt bearing the company name is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the record format requested by your company. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では飲み物分と食品分のレシートを別にお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then we'll give separate till receipts for the drinks and food.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。飲み物を一回、食品を次の一回で、商品が混ざらないか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会計順序と商品区分を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Drinks in one transaction, then food in the next; I'll check the items aren't mixed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm payment order and item separation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。最初に会社用の飲み物だけ会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. First we'll ring up only the company drinks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。受け取った二枚に自分で区別を付けて、会社には飲み物の分だけ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚を区別して会社分だけ提出すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll mark the two receipts to distinguish them and give the company only the drinks receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to distinguish the two receipts and submit only the company portion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの会計とレシートを分けて進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll proceed with separate transactions and receipts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 放送について何かご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the announcement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: サイレンが聞こえました。訓練の紙を見たので、何もせず待てばいいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: サイレンを古い掲示から訓練だと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard a siren. Since I saw a drill notice, I thought I should wait without doing anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you assumed the siren was a drill based on an old notice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の案内を聞き取れましたか。以前の紙だけで現在の状況は決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you hear the current instructions clearly? Don't judge the present situation from an earlier paper alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 内容は聞き取れませんでした。今日の訓練なのか、どこへ動く案内なのか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在の放送を聞けず内容確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I couldn't understand the content. I'd like to check whether it's today's drill and where we're being told to go.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you missed the current announcement and request its content. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では、今行っている訓練の集合案内です。担当者が場所を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this situation, it's an assembly instruction for the drill now in progress. The staff will explain the location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。ただの音だと無視するのでなく、今の指示を確認して参加の扱いを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今の指示を確認し訓練参加の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. Instead of ignoring it as just a sound, I'll check the current instructions and ask how drill participation is handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check current instructions and ask about drill participation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訓練の担当者へご案内します。実際の緊急案内が出た場合は、その案内に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll direct you to drill staff. If actual emergency instructions are issued, follow those.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。次の放送も聞き、分からなければ担当者に聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次の案内も確認し不明時は聞き直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll listen to the next announcement too and ask the staff again if unclear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check further instructions and ask again if unclear. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同行の方にも、今分かった内容を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell those with you what you've learned now too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族には訓練の集合案内と確認できたことを伝え、集合先は担当者の説明で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認済みの内容だけ家族へ伝え集合先を担当者に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my family we've confirmed it's a drill assembly announcement, and confirm the assembly point through the staff's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell family only confirmed content and ask staff where to assemble. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの担当者から、現在の集合案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Receive the current assembly instructions from this staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の底がぬれているようですが、大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The bottom of your luggage seems wet. Is everything okay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鉢植えを運んでいます。朝水をやったので、箱から少し漏れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鉢植えと漏水の原因として水やりを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm carrying a potted plant. I watered it this morning, so a little water is leaking from the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the potted plant and watering as the cause of leaking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 床や他のお客様の物へ漏れる状態では、まず対処が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: If it is leaking onto the floor or other passengers' belongings, that must be addressed first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このまま乗らず、水が外へ出ないように包み直したいです。通路をふさがない場所でできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗車を待ち安全な場所で包み直したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I won't board like this. I'd like to rewrap it so water can't escape. Can I do it somewhere that won't block the passage?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Wait to board and ask to rewrap in a safe place. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 係員が場所を確認します。持ち込めるかは大きさや状態も見てご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff will check a location. We'll also look at size and condition before explaining whether it can be carried aboard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。箱はこの大きさです。水だけ止めれば必ず持ち込めるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大きさと状態の確認も必要だと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. The box is this size. I won't assume stopping the water guarantees I can bring it aboard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Understand size and condition need checking too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。包み直した後にも状態を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Let's check its condition after rewrapping too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋を持っているので、鉢と箱を分けて包みます。こぼれた所もスタッフに伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 包み直す方法と既に漏れた場所を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have bags, so I'll wrap the pot and box separately. I'll tell staff where the water already spilled too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain how you will rewrap and report existing spills. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。清掃は係員が対応します。広げず、その場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Staff will handle cleaning. Don't spread it; tell us the spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここです。荷物は案内された場所で包み直し、確認が済んでから乗車を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対処後の確認を受けてから乗車を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here. I'll rewrap the luggage in the designated place, then discuss boarding after the check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Consult about boarding after addressing and checking the problem. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず漏れた場所と作業場所を係員へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First I'll tell staff the spill location and work location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 希望する園は、この順番でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this your preferred order of childcare facilities?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三つ書きましたが、優先順位ではありません。思いついた順に並べました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列挙順は希望順位ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've listed three, but it's not a ranking. I wrote them as I thought of them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the listed order is not your preference ranking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面の用紙は希望順を確認する欄です。まだ順位が決まっていないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this situation, the form confirms preference order. So you haven't decided the ranking yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。私が駅に近い園、妻が家に近い園を希望していて、まだ相談中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族で優先したい条件が違うと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Right. I prefer one near the station; my wife prefers one near home. We're still discussing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show family members prioritize different conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当者が用紙の書き方と、確認できる園の情報をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff will explain how to fill in the form and what facility information can be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。空きがあると聞いた園もありますが、入れると決まったわけではないですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 空き情報と申込み結果の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I heard one has vacancies, but that doesn't mean admission is decided, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the difference between vacancy information and application results. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、空きについての情報と、申込みの結果は別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct. Vacancy information and the application outcome are separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。通園の距離だけでなく、送迎する人と時間も家族で考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送迎する人と時間も含めて条件を比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. We'll consider who does drop-off and pickup and at what times, not only the distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare conditions including pickup person and times. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 順位が決まってから、記入内容を確認して申込みをご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: After deciding the order, check your entries and consult about applying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は下書きとして書き方を聞き、家族で順番を決めるまで正式に出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族の順位決定までは下書き相談に留める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Today I'll ask how to fill it as a draft and won't formally submit until the family decides the order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep it a draft consultation until the family decides rankings. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。希望順が未確定の記入相談として担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll refer it to staff as form-filling advice with the preference order undecided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子様もご一緒ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your child is with you too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私が診察室にいる間、待合で子どもを見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察中の子どもの預かりを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. While I'm in the consulting room, could someone watch my child in the waiting room?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about childcare during your consultation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面では、子どもの預かりは行っていません。同行の扱いを担当者へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this situation, we don't provide childcare. I'll ask staff about accompaniment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 診察を受けることと、子どもを預けることは別なんですね。一人で待たせない方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受診と預かりを区別し単独待機を避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Seeing the doctor and childcare are separate, then. I'd like to discuss a way to avoid leaving my child alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish consultation from childcare and ask to avoid the child waiting alone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お子様の年齢と、ほかの保護者が来られるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell me the child's age and whether another guardian can come.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四歳です。夫に連絡できますが、すぐ来られるかは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子どもの年齢と家族の対応が未確認だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Four. I can contact my husband, but haven't asked if he can come right away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the child's age and that family availability is unconfirmed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者へ同行について確認し、ご家族への連絡もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check accompaniment with staff; please contact your family too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。診察室へ入れると自分で決めず、夫が来る場合の待ち時間も相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診察同行や家族到着を担当者と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't decide myself the child can enter the room; I'll also ask about waiting if my husband comes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Consult staff about accompanying the consultation or family arrival. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。今はお子様と一緒にお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. For now wait together with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。預かってもらえると思って離れず、担当者と家族の返事を聞いてから動きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 子どもから離れず返答を待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I won't leave assuming they'll provide childcare; I'll move only after hearing staff and family replies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to stay with the child and await replies. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お子様の同行と待機について担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll refer the child's accompaniment and waiting arrangements to staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの説明のまとめをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check this summary of your explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この行は「人が入るのを見た」とありますが、私は見ていません。言葉が伝わっていないようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記録の肯定が自分の否定発言と違うと指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: This line says 'I saw someone enter,' but I didn't. It seems my words haven't come across correctly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the positive record differs from your negative statement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、実際に確認したことをもう一度教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then tell me again what you actually confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 帰宅した時に扉が開いていたことだけです。入った人や開けた時刻は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 確認した扉の状態と未目撃の人・時刻を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only that the door was open when I came home. I didn't see who entered or when it was opened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the confirmed door condition from unseen people and times. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。否定の部分も含め、内容を確認し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. I'll recheck the details, including the negative parts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。私の日本語が聞き取りにくければ、短い文に分けて書いて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 短い筆記説明を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. If my Japanese is hard to understand, I'll write short separate sentences to explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suggest a short written explanation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、書いた説明も確認できます。分からない表現はそのまま尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, we can check the written explanation too. Ask directly about any expressions you don't understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 記録に難しい言葉があります。意味が分からないまま、合っていますと返事をしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明語を理解するまで記録に同意しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are difficult words in the record. I won't say it's correct without understanding their meaning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you won't agree to the record until unclear words are understood. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者が意味を説明し、訂正した内容を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Staff will explain the meanings and check the corrected contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。扉が開いていたことと、人は見ていないことの両方が記録されているか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 事実と否定の両方が反映されたか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I'll check both that the door was open and that I saw no person are recorded.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check both the fact and the negative statement are reflected. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。否定を含む内容を訂正し、ご本人の説明として再確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll correct the details including the negatives and reconfirm it as your own account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 再配達のご希望ですね。通知を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like redelivery. I'll check the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。明日の昼に職場へ持ってきてほしいです。時間を選べば住所も変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再配達の時間選択で住所も変わるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like it at work tomorrow midday. If I choose a time, does the address change too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether choosing a redelivery time changes the address too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 時刻の希望と、配達先の変更は別の確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Time preferences and delivery-address changes require separate checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 勤務先の住所をここに書けば済むと思いました。住所変更ができるか先に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛先変更の可否を先に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought writing the workplace address here was enough. First tell me whether the destination can be changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check first whether changing the destination is possible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 郵便物の種類と通知番号を担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff will check the mail type and notice number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この通知です。勤務先で個人の荷物を受け取ってよいかも、会社へまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知を示し勤務先での受け取り許可も未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here's the notice. I also haven't asked my company if I may receive personal parcels at work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the notice and say workplace receipt permission is unconfirmed too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も先に確認してください。変更先だけでなく、受け取りが可能な方法を考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check that first as well. Let's think of a feasible receiving method, not just a changed address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。会社の確認が取れなければ、自宅で受け取れる別の日時を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務先不可なら自宅の別日時を検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. If company permission isn't obtained, I'll ask about another date and time when I can receive it at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Consider another home delivery date/time if work isn't possible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今は時刻も住所も確定せず、条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. For now we'll check conditions without finalizing time or address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。再配達の日時と場所を分けて確認し、受け取れる方法が決まってから依頼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日時と場所の条件を確認後に依頼を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll check redelivery date/time and location separately and request it once a receiving method is decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Finalize the request after checking time and location conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通知の種類と配達先変更の条件を担当者へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll ask staff about the notice type and conditions for changing the delivery destination.
